summary: The video features a 300 Heliolite Dice summoning session on the Selected Summons banner to obtain the new Legendary hero Syonis. The creator discusses a strategy shift from skipping banners to hunt maxed Inspiration meta heroes to pulling for every new hero. Over 300 pulls, five Legendary heroes were summoned: Daphne (twice), Torrin, Aspalta, and Stanguem. Syonis was claimed as the 300-pull milestone reward. The creator highlights Syonis's potential, especially his Inspiration 5 skill which can reduce enemy Defense by up to 60% based on Enlightenment.

heroes.name: Syonis
heroes.verdict: Strong Necrosis damage dealer and defense debuffer
heroes.note: His Inspiration 5 passive reduces enemy Defense by up to 60% based on Enlightenment, boosting team damage significantly in Arena and PvE.

heroes.name: Torrin
heroes.verdict: Niche healer used mostly in early seasons
heroes.note: Useful in Season 1 and Season 2 for healing and debuff immunity, but largely forgotten in later seasons.

heroes.name: Saverio
heroes.note: Synergizes strongly with Syonis, whose Defense reduction can significantly amplify Saverio's overall damage output.

tips: Save enough Heliolite Dice to hit the 300-summon selector threshold to guarantee target seasonal Legendary heroes.
Build Syonis with high Enlightenment to maximize his passive Defense penalty, which scales up to a 60% Defense reduction.
